title: An integral regular summand in every staircase Specht tensor cube
abstract_tex: For every staircase partition $\rho=(m,m-1,\ldots,1)$ of $N=m(m+1)/2$, we prove that the integral regular module $\Z[S_N]$ is a direct summand of $(S^\rho_{\Z})^{\otimes3}$. Ordered row and column polytabloids give a tensor whose translates form a basis of that summand. A single integral coordinate functional gives an explicit equivariant retraction. The splitting survives base change to every commutative unital ring, including nonflat base change, with no restriction on the characteristic. The proof uses the separating-product mechanism of Bryant and Kov\'acs, Ikenmeyer's triangular palette uniqueness, and a square-deficit calculation from the pinned cyclic-polytabloid construction.
abstract_plain_text: For every staircase partition rho=(m,m-1,...,1) of N=m(m+1)/2, we prove that the integral regular module Z[S_N] is a direct summand of (S_Z^rho)^{tensor 3}. Ordered row and column polytabloids give a tensor whose translates form a basis of that summand. A single integral coordinate functional gives an explicit equivariant retraction. The splitting survives base change to every commutative unital ring, including nonflat base change, with no restriction on the characteristic. The proof uses the separating-product mechanism of Bryant and Kovács, Ikenmeyer's triangular palette uniqueness, and a square-deficit calculation from the pinned cyclic-polytabloid construction.
